name: C10-0005/2026 – Commission proposal
title: Regulation implementing enhanced cooperation on the establishment of the Ukraine Support Loan for 2026 and 2027 ***I
part_text:
The European Union wants to approve new rules for how a joint committee runs its meetings. This committee was set up under an agreement on international coach and bus travel, which covers regular and special regular passenger services between the EU and countries such as the United Kingdom, Ukraine and the Western Balkans. The rules would cover the committee's secretariat and meetings. The Council is asked to authorise the Commission to agree to these rules on the EU's behalf.

- What changes: the committee gets written rules on its secretariat and meetings.
- Who it affects: EU countries and partner countries running coach and bus services.
- What happens next: EU representatives back the draft rules at the committee's next meeting.
